verifications.claim: Starting with the 2026 season, Sunday Night Baseball has moved to NBC and Peacock, ending its long run on ESPN.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "From 1990 to 2025, Sunday Night Baseball was on ESPN. That will change in 2026, with NBC and Peacock taking over." (R2); "The Sunday showcase had aired on ESPN since 1990, but Sunday Night Baseball is now on NBC." (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the move from ESPN to NBC/Peacock starting in 2026.

verifications.claim: Sunday Night Baseball games air weekly on Sunday evenings.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NBC Sports 2026 MLB schedule features 27 primetime games across a mix of Sunday Night Baseball" (R1); "Every Sunday Night Baseball game this season will air on either NBC or Peacock" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe it as a weekly Sunday primetime series.

verifications.claim: Sunday Night Baseball games are broadcast on NBC.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Schedules list many games as "NBC/Peacock" but others as "Peacock" only, e.g., "March 29... Cleveland Guardians at Seattle Mariners — Peacock" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: Supported for many games, but not all; some are Peacock exclusive, so less precise.

verifications.claim: Sunday Night Baseball games are streamed on Peacock Premium.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Just make sure you have Peacock Premium or Plus. Games won't be available for those in the Select tier." (R4)

verifications.claim: Sunday Night Baseball games are often simulcast on NBCSN.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention NBCSN simulcast only for specific games (e.g., debut), no mention of 'often' or frequency.

verifications.claim: The new era begins with the Cleveland Guardians vs. Seattle Mariners on March 29, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Then Sunday Night Baseball debuts March 29 at 7 p.m. ET on Peacock with... Cleveland Guardians and Seattle Mariners." (R1); "The first game on a Sunday night is March 29, when the Seattle Mariners host the Cleveland Guardians." (R2)
verifications.reasoning: All schedules confirm exact matchup and date as season debut.

verifications.claim: Peacock (Premium/Plus) streams all Sunday Night games.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "you can always find Sunday Night Baseball streaming on Peacock." (R3); "Peacock Premium or Plus" (R4); schedules list all as Peacock or NBC/Peacock (R2, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm all games stream on Peacock, with Premium/Plus specified.

verifications.claim: Jason Benetti serves as the lead play-by-play announcer for NBC Sports.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jason Benetti will be the play-by-play voice for Sunday Night Baseball" (R2); "Jason Benetti... lead play-by-play announcer for Sunday Night Baseball" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Directly named as lead announcer for NBC Sports' Sunday Night Baseball.

verifications.claim: Peacock streams an exclusive afternoon "Sunday Leadoff" game in addition to the night game.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "18 MLB Sunday Leadoff games that will kick off the day’s action on Peacock" (R1); "NBC will stream the “Sunday Leadoff” game each week on Peacock." (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm weekly exclusive Peacock Sunday Leadoff afternoon games.

verifications.claim: March 29, 2026: Cleveland Guardians at Seattle Mariners (Peacock/NBCSN).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "March 29 — 7 p.m. — Cleveland Guardians at Seattle Mariners — Peacock" (R1); "simulcast on NBCSports Network" (R4); "Peacock and NBCSN" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Matchup and date exact; Peacock confirmed universally, NBCSN in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: April 5, 2026: St. Louis Cardinals at Chicago Cubs (NBC/Peacock).
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "April 5 — 7 p.m. — St. Louis Cardinals at Detroit Tigers — Peacock" (R1, R2, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Date and teams match but opponent is Detroit Tigers, not Chicago Cubs.

verifications.claim: April 12, 2026: Cleveland Guardians at Atlanta Braves (NBC/Peacock).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 12 — 7 p.m. — Cleveland Guardians at Atlanta Braves — NBC/Peacock" (R1, R2, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Exact matchup, date, and broadcast platforms confirmed.

verifications.claim: April 19, 2026: Atlanta Braves at Philadelphia Phillies (Peacock).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 19 — 7 p.m. — Atlanta Braves at Philadelphia Phillies — Peacock" (R1, R2, R7)
